svg.title: Windows decodes SDR with the sRGB curve; the content was mastered for gamma 2.2
svg.desc: Two transfer functions plotted against signal level. Across the full range they are nearly identical. Below about 40 percent signal the sRGB curve sits above gamma 2.2, and in the deep shadows it emits far more light: 2.9 times as much at 5 percent signal and 1.6 times at 10 percent.

g.text: The whole range, where nothing looks wrong
The shadows, where all of it lives
Gamma 2.2, as the work was mastered
